# SilverGlow British Shorthair

> Reputable British Shorthair and Longhair cattery specializing in Silver and Gold cats. Located in Tryavna, Bulgaria. Kittens raised at home, well-socialized, registered with pedigrees, and fully vaccinated. Worldwide shipping available.

## About Us
SilverGlow is a registered British Shorthair cattery in Tryavna, Bulgaria. We breed Silver and Gold British Shorthair and British Longhair cats with certified pedigrees. All kittens are home-raised, well-socialized, fully vaccinated, and microchipped before leaving us.

## Our Cats
- Studs: Champion-titled British Shorthair males with excellent pedigrees
- Queens: Carefully selected breeding females for health, temperament, and breed standard
- Available Kittens: Pedigree kittens with vaccinations and health guarantees
